title: Legacy Compose build does not enable BuildKit
symptom: The ARM64 backend image build reaches uv sync and stops with 'the --mount option requires BuildKit'.
reproduction_steps: Start Colima with Docker proxy configured
Run the project Compose build using the installed docker-compose command
Observe backend Dockerfile step RUN --mount=type=cache fail
hypothesis: The installed legacy docker-compose invocation uses the classic builder unless DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 is exported or the Dockerfile cache mount is removed.

title: Production root credential exposed through third-party web SSH URL
symptom: The remote terminal tab is a third-party web SSH service whose URL embeds server authentication material and remains stuck connecting.
reproduction_steps: Do not reopen or share the credential-bearing URL
Reset the server root password in the cloud provider control panel
Install the prepared root public key locally with ssh-copy-id
hypothesis: Rotating the password and completing bootstrap through the local OpenSSH client removes third-party credential handling and enables safe key-only hardening.
evidence: browser DOM identifies an online third-party SSH tool
no secret was copied into project files or tool commands

reason: Production SSH now enforces public-key-only authentication; root and deploy keys were independently verified after reload, password and keyboard-interactive attempts are rejected, and the third-party tab was closed. Final closure awaits explicit confirmation that the cloud-panel root password was rotated after exposure.
evidence: password-only probe rejected with Permission denied (publickey)

reason: The user confirmed the exposed root password was rotated after the third-party session; production SSH remains public-key-only and both deploy/root keys were reverified after rotation.

title: Archived Fitness exercise blocks a later exercise create
symptom: POST /api/v1/fitness/exercises returns HTTP 409 Exercise order already exists after the only active exercise was archived.
reproduction_steps: Create an exercise in an otherwise empty plan
Archive that exercise without deleting its row
Create another exercise in the same plan without an explicit sort_order
Observe that active-only allocation reuses sort_order 0 and violates uq_fitness_exercise_order
hypothesis: Automatic sort allocation must compute the next order across all exercises in the plan, including archived rows.
evidence: production access log recorded authenticated mobile POST with HTTP 409
backend create_exercise currently reads repository.active_exercises only

title: Production deploy backup preflight omits required RELEASE_SHA
symptom: deploy-production.sh checks the running database with docker compose before exporting RELEASE_SHA, so Compose interpolation fails and the guarded backup branch is skipped.
reproduction_steps: Run deploy-production.sh while the production stack is already active
Observe docker compose ps -q db emit required variable RELEASE_SHA is missing
Observe the conditional treats the failed probe as false and continues without backup
hypothesis: Pass an explicit existing release SHA to the Compose preflight and backup command, and statically assert this ordering in the deployment contract test.
evidence: post-deploy backup count remained 2 and latest backup predated this release
production data counts remained 4 plans, 3 exercises, 1 archived exercise, 3 sessions and 8 sets
